sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal: neutral market fear/greed, no congressional buy/sell consensus, minimal recent insider activity (small amounts, 156+ days old), and no news data available.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (301.12) with imminent NFP event and earnings in 24 days creates hostile macro backdrop for real estate sector.
